name: Home AI Studio
tagline: AI Sketch to Render | Interior Design & Architecture Rendering
description: Home AI Studio is an AI design platform for architects, interior designers, landscape designers, and homeowners. Upload a sketch, photo, or 3D model and get cinema-quality renders in ~10 seconds. Tools cover architecture sketch-to-render, room redesign and style transfer, facade and day/night conversion, and landscape/garden visualization. Free tier: 50 credits/month. Pro from $19/mo.
